prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Create a new wordless comic panel in the project's polished dimensional children's animation style. Landscape 1672x941. Three friends have returned to Earth and have an important job: carefully digging for fossils together.
The three supplied images are STRICT canonical character model sheets, not loose inspiration. Image 1 Odette, image 2 Eclipse, image 3 Diana. Preserve each one's precise identity, head-to-body proportions, face, eye colour, hairstyle, outfit, crown and accessories. Exactly these THREE characters, one of each. DIANA is the third character, NOT Aurora.
Odette is a NORMAL little human girl again: her original shoulder-length straight dark brown hair and swept fringe, lavender hair clip, enormous sparkling BLUE eyes, lavender jumper with white ruffled neckline and hem, dark navy leggings with pink hearts, lavender shoes. No wings, tail, helmet, space suit or rockets. Preserve her original large head and little child body.
Eclipse is back to her original fairy appearance from image 2: huge pale-lavender rounded head, enormous purple eyes, pointed silver-lilac curl, dark glittery angular hairline, long wavy silver-lilac hair, original tall spiky dark purple crystal crown, dark purple and black star-patterned outfit with gold chest emblem, original tiny shoes. NO spacesuit or helmet.
Diana is back to her original fairy appearance from image 3: huge pale face, blue-purple starry eyes, long pastel lilac-pink-blue hair with delicate floral ornaments, original tall gold pointed crown with blue/pink inlays and gemstones, gold-chain pink diamond forehead jewellery, pale blue dress with gold emblem and cream scalloped hem, original translucent flower-decorated veil/cape. NO spacesuit or helmet. Fairy bodies tiny and compact below oversized heads, do not elongate their torsos or turn them into human girls.
Scene: a sunny, peaceful outdoor fossil excavation on Earth, a shallow sandy excavation bed in a low layered-rock clearing with green hills, grass and blue sky beyond. Warm natural morning light. All three kneel or crouch around the same patch of exposed stone in the foreground, busy and gently focused, exchanging excited smiles while doing a careful job. Odette at left-centre carefully uses a soft little brush to reveal a recognisable spiral ammonite fossil still embedded in a flat rock; Eclipse at right uses a small hand trowel to move loose sand beside it, not striking the fossil; Diana at centre-back holds a magnifying glass over another faint shell impression, with a shallow padded collection tray beside her. A small bucket and spare brush sit nearby. Tools sized to their small hands. Their crowns and heads stay fully in frame; their distinct costumes and faces remain clearly recognisable. Make the fossil and cooperative work visually readable. A few simple stakes and string mark the shallow dig area.
Important job communicated purely by the focused activity, no signs, no diagrams with text, no speech bubbles. No space backdrop, no castle, no astronauts, no extra characters, no giant skeleton, no living dinosaur or new plot event. Rich tactile rock textures, soft rounded toy-like character materials, cheerful adventurous storybook atmosphere. No text, logos or watermark.
